snippet.title: Game trailer "Sadko" [ENG]
snippet.description:
#sadkogame #sadko #gametrailers #gaming 
Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.
